presets.name: Dinner is ready
presets.description: The uploaded person cheerfully announces dinner and is fed a crispy spring roll in a warm kitchen.
presets.prompt: Use the uploaded portrait as the identity reference. Create one continuous four-second medium shot of the same person in a warm, bright home kitchen, wearing a simple apron. Preserve their facial features, face shape, skin tone and hairstyle. They look into the camera, grin and cheerfully announce that dinner is ready; then a hand enters from the side and playfully feeds them a crispy golden spring roll, and they take a happy bite. Playful meme energy, handheld phone-camera feel, natural blink and head movement, warm lighting. Keep the face stable and recognizable. No scene cuts, no text, no logos, no morphing.
